How to use this document
These are the 62 questions that make a sitting fruitful, answered from this nativity. Tropical psychology is used only where it
names a behaviour (self-cancellation, overthinking). Timing and life-area predictions are Parashari: Lahiri sidereal,
whole-sign houses from 23 Aquarius, Vimshottari from Purva Phalguni Moon. Method is paraphrased from Charak, Braha,
Sutton, Levacy, DiCara, Houlding, Marks, Greene, Rushman, Singer, and Hill -- not copied. Chart placements are
observations. Events are inferences until they happen. Health notes are not diagnosis.
THE 7-YEAR SPINE (2022-2029)
Mangala mahadasha. 10th lord Mars in lagna. Yogakaraka Venus exalted in the 2nd has not yet run as antardasha. That
antardasha is 20 July 2027 to 18 September 2028. Everything before it is preparation and cutting. Everything after it, until Rahu
mahadasha in August 2029, is title and handover. Ashtama Shani (Saturn in the 8th from Leo Moon) runs 2025 into 2028 and is
the friction on that spine.
A. Before the sitting -- data and honesty
1. Is my birth time accurate enough for lagna, navamsa, and dasha -- or should we rectify first?
Rasi lagna at 23 Aquarius 08' is stable. Lagna would not become Pisces unless the clock were roughly 25-30 minutes later.
Vimshottari is from the Moon (17 Leo), which moves about 1 degree in two hours, so dasha balance is robust at 3:57 AM.
Navamsa lagna is Gemini at the very end of that navamsa (about 0.2 degrees of zodiac remaining). That can flip to Cancer
with a birth-time error of only a few minutes. If D9 spouse details in this document feel wrong, rectify before you treat
navamsa as law. Ask a jyotishi to match: appearance, a parent's event, and the 2022 Saturn-return / Mars-dasha onset.
2. Which system are you using, and will you say so when a point is uncertain?
This file: Lahiri ayanamsa (about 23.75 at birth), whole-sign houses from Aquarius, Placidus mentioned only when
comparing the earlier Western reading. True Node. Vimshottari. Uncertain points are flagged: D9 lagna, exact marriage day,
and whether Kuja dosha is counted (see Q35). A good astrologer names the ayanamsa. If they will not, the sitting is already
leaky.
3. Please use rasi and navamsa. Which other vargas for career, marriage, and children?
Minimum: D1 (rasi) + D9 (navamsa, marriage and inner dharma). For this chart also ask D10 (dasamsa) because 10th lord
Mars is in lagna in his own mahadasha -- career is the plot. D7 (saptamsa) for children because Ketu sits in the 5th. D12 for
parents (Saturn in 12th, 4th lord Venus exalted). D60 only if the astrologer actually uses it; most do not, and a fake D60 is
worse than none. Braha and Charak both treat house lords in D1 as the backbone. Vargas refine; they do not replace lords.
4. What is not promised in this chart, so I stop chasing it?
Not promised as an easy default: (1) a quiet life as the unnamed loyal employee forever -- 10th lord in lagna will not stay
invisible; (2) a shrinking, purely accommodating wife -- 7th is Leo with Magha Jupiter and an exalted Sun as 7th lord; (3) fast
unearned cash -- Saturn aspects the 2nd from own-sign 12th; money is delayed then durable; (4) a large flock of children on a
family timetable -- Ketu in the 5th; (5) staying only in the birth city with no inner cost -- lagna lord in the 12th; (6) a
personality that is only gentle or only blunt -- the engine is friction, not a single mask. Lottery, overnight fame, and a
conflict-free marriage are not the fruit of this kundali. Built name, a proud equal, and foreign or behind-the-scenes mastery
are.
B. Chart engine
5. What is the one planetary combination that will matter most for the next 7 years?
Mars as 10th (and 3rd) lord in lagna, running his mahadasha until 27 August 2029, then handing to Rahu in the 11th. The
combination that cashes it is Mars dasha + Venus antardasha (yogakaraka, exalted, 2nd house) in 2027-28, supported by
Jupiter transiting the 7th (Leo). That is career-made-visible plus marriage/money. Secondary combination: Mercury neecha
bhanga in the 2nd with that same Venus -- the current year (to Feb 2027) is the contract that Venus later spends.

6. How do lagna lord Saturn in the 12th (own sign) and 10th lord Mars in lagna work together?
Saturn in Capricorn in the 12th is strong and cadent: foreign lands, hospitals, ashrams, research, sleep, exile, and expenses
that structure the self. Houlding's 12th is self-undoing if you use disappearance as medicine. Charak's lagna lord in 12th is not
automatic ruin when the planet is in own sign -- it is a life that matures off-stage. Mars in lagna wants the stage now. Fruitful
pattern: do the 12th-house work (craft, foreign, unseen hours) and let Mars put a name on it. Unfruitful pattern: Mars starts,
Saturn 12th deletes, Virgo-like quality control (Moon in 7th) calls the delay virtue. Together they describe a self-made
professional who often lives or earns away from the birthplace, with a private inner life that must not swallow the public one.
7. Venus is yogakaraka and exalted in the 2nd. When does that yoga actually pay?
Charak: Venus for Aquarius is yoga-karaka because she owns a kendra (4th) and a trikona (9th). Exalted in Pisces in the 2nd
she is a dhana yoga sitting on family, speech, and accumulations. Venus mahadasha was 1992-2006 -- childhood and teens.
Yogakaraka in youth often lays taste, values, and family karma rather than a house and a title. It pays when Venus runs as
antardasha inside a kendra-lord dasha: Mars-Venus, 20 July 2027 to 18 September 2028. A second cash-out is Rahu-Venus,
March 2041 to March 2044, larger and more worldly. Do not wait for 2041 if 2027-28 is available.
8. Mercury is debilitated in the 2nd. Is there real neecha bhanga, and what does that mean now?
Yes. Mercury at 6 Pisces is in the sign of debilitation (peak is 15 Pisces, so it is approaching, not at worst). Cancellation:
Jupiter, lord of Pisces, is in a kendra from lagna (7th) and conjunct the Moon. Mercury is exalted in navamsa Virgo. Neecha
bhanga raja yoga is the name; the lived meaning is: speech, documents, and commerce fail the first version and succeed the
corrected one. Mars-Mercury (24 Feb 2026 - 21 Feb 2027) is that signature as a year. Do not treat the first rejection as the
verdict. Revise once, then file. Do not revise forever -- that is the 12th house pretending to be Mercury.
9. The Sun is exalted and vargottama as 7th lord. What does that demand in marriage and public life?
Sun at 0 Aries, Ashwini pada 1, same sign in D9: vargottama and in exaltation sign (exact exaltation is 10 Aries; still the sign
of strength). As 7th lord in the 3rd: spouse and public honour come through your own courage, voice, short decisive moves,
siblings, or craft -- not through waiting to be chosen. DiCara: Ashwini is the stallion, the twin physicians, vitality and the start
of the zodiac. Demand: initiate. In marriage the Sun as 7th lord wants respect and a partner who does not dim your will. In
public life it wants a name. A marriage that requires you to become small will not last this 7th lord.
10. Jupiter retrograde in the 7th (Magha): delayed spouse, internalized teacher, or both?
Both. Charak's 7th-house Jupiter: association with a spouse of character, honour. Retrograde: the guru function turns inward
first. Magha (DiCara): throne, ancestors, inherited power -- the spouse has dignity or a family that takes itself seriously.
Delay is not denial. D9 Jupiter in own-sign Pisces supports a real bond. You marry after you have become, in private, the
teacher you kept looking for in other people. That is why Mars-Venus plus Jupiter gochara in Leo (2027-28) is the clock, not
a random 'good year'.
11. Ketu in the 5th: children, romance, speculation -- delay, few, or spiritual -- and what not to force in
Mars-Ketu?
Ketu in the 5th (Gemini, Ardra): past-life intelligence, unconventional romance, detachment from the ordinary child-script.
Braha lists the 5th as children, poorvapunya, speculation, love affairs. Ketu there often thins or spiritualizes those things
rather than forbidding them. Prediction: children delayed or few; romance that refuses the family template; speculation that
can cut as well as pay. Mars-Ketu (21 Feb - 20 Jul 2027): do not force engagement, pregnancy timing, or high-leverage bets.
Ketu's job is to end the false 5th-house story so Venus can start a true one.
12. Rahu in the 11th in Mula: what must be uprooted before the 2030s gains?
Mula is the root. Rahu in the 11th wants large networks, foreign gains, unconventional status. Mula will not let a polite small
life survive. What must be uprooted: the 12th-house habit of being indispensable and unnamed; family roles that close the
10th; relationships in which you are the project manager of someone else's will; the fantasy that more research will replace a
decision. Rahu mahadasha 27 Aug 2029 - 22 Aug 2047. If Mars dasha has already put a name on the work, Rahu scales it. If
not, Rahu inflates invisibility into a public emptiness.

13. From Chandra lagna (Leo), what changes that the lagna chart hides?
Moon in Leo: 10th from Moon is Taurus, ruled by Venus -- career from the mind/public also pays through Venus (exalted in
2nd from lagna = 8th from Moon: research, others' money, transformation, foreign shared resources). 7th from Moon is
Aquarius: the partner is the lagna itself -- you marry someone who feels like a missing piece of identity, or you project your
unlived self onto them (7th lord of rasi is Sun; 7th from Moon is Saturn-ruled). Ashtama Shani is Saturn in Pisces, 8th from
Moon -- this is why 2025-28 feels like hidden tests even when lagna-Saturn is strong. Health from Chandra: 6th from Moon is
Capricorn (natal Saturn there in the 12th from lagna) -- chronic, structural, sleep/foreign fatigue. Lagna chart shows pitta;
Chandra chart shows the long grind.
14. Which houses are empty but still active through their lords -- and which empty house am I neglecting?
Empty in D1 whole-sign: 4th Taurus (lord Venus exalted in 2nd -- home/vehicles will come through money yoga, not through
a planet sitting in the 4th), 6th Cancer (lord Moon in 7th -- enemies, debt, and illness play out through relationship and work),
8th Virgo (lord Mercury in 2nd -- in-laws, taxes, sex, occult, sudden events speak as documents and family money), 9th Libra
(lord Venus in 2nd -- dharma and father pay as wealth and values, neglected if you only chase 6th-house labour), 10th
Scorpio (lord Mars in lagna -- the career house is empty because YOU are the career; neglecting it means staying in the 6th as
the unnamed specialist). The neglected house is the 10th: you over-live 6th/12th service and under-claim 10th reputation.
North Node in tropical 10th said the same in the other system.
C. Timing
15. Confirm Mars MD / Mercury AD until 21 Feb 2027 -- fruit and caution.
Confirmed from Purva Phalguni Moon, Venus remainder 14.38 years at birth. Mars MD 28 Aug 2022 - 27 Aug 2029.
Mercury AD 24 Feb 2026 - 21 Feb 2027. Fruit: contracts, exams, visas, offers, speech, commerce, a 5th-house idea becoming
a 2nd-house invoice. Neecha bhanga: first no, then yes. Caution: 8th-lord Mercury -- sudden bills, in-law/tax/intimacy
reveals, nervous system, skin, gut. Charak's adverse Mercury-under-Mars list includes loss and anguish when Mercury is
weak. Yours is weak in rasi, cancelled in yoga. Treat obstacles as drafts. Pratyantara: Rahu 13 Sep - 6 Nov 2026
(foreign/online, do not rush-sign); Jupiter 6 Nov - 24 Dec 2026 (best settlement of this AD); Saturn 24 Dec 2026 - 19 Feb
2027 (finish, do not launch).
16. What should I complete before Mars-Ketu (Feb-Jul 2027), and what must I not start then?
Complete: the contract, the portfolio, the medical checkup, the conversation that Mercury is already forcing, savings buffer, a
clean break from a dead role if the papers can be signed in Jupiter pratyantara (Nov-Dec 2026). Do not start in Ketu AD:
wedding, company incorporation, pregnancy-as-plan, leveraged speculation, a new identity that requires Rahu-on-lagna
theatre. Ketu in the 5th under Mars: endings, spiritual reset, surgical honesty. Jupiter will already be touching Leo (7th) from
Nov 2026 / Jan 2027 and again Jul 2027 -- you will feel destiny. Ketu strips the fantasy. Venus builds after 20 July 2027.
17. Is July 2027-Sep 2028 (Mars-Venus) truly my prime window? What would cancel or weaken it?
Yes, for this decade. Yogakaraka exalted Venus inside 10th-lord Mars dasha, Jupiter in or repeating through Leo (7th) Jul
2027 through much of 2028, Saturn leaving ashtama into Aries (9th from Moon) from July 2027. What weakens it: (1)
marrying or incorporating in the Ketu AD just before it because you are impatient; (2) refusing visibility -- Saturn 12th
deleting Venus; (3) picking a yes-person spouse so Mars in lagna has no equal, then resenting them; (4) chaotic birth time that
actually puts D9 elsewhere -- rectify if the Venus story feels alien; (5) untreated health in Ashtama Shani so the body cannot
hold the harvest. What does not cancel it: fear. Fear is not a graha.
18. How do Ashtama Shani and Rahu on the lagna change those dasha results through 2028?
Ashtama Shani: Saturn in Pisces, 8th from natal Moon, from about April 2025, with a tail into early 2028 (Saturn dips back to
Pisces late 2027 / Jan 2028). Hidden obstacles, taxes, elder health, chronic worry, delays on 2nd-house money (Saturn also
transits the 2nd from lagna). It does not delete Mars dasha; it charges a toll. Pay in sleep, accounts, and honesty. Rahu
gochara on Aquarius lagna through 2026 into early 2027 (by Jan 2027 Rahu is already in Capricorn). Identity restlessness,
foreign pull, the urge to reinvent the face. Do not emigrate, operate, or tattoo a new self on a mood. Pick one name. Together:
the dasha says act; the transits say act with paperwork and a body that has slept.

19. When Jupiter transits my 7th (Leo), what events are likely vs. merely a good feeling?
Sutton: Jupiter on the 7th or contacting the 7th lord / Venus is a classic marriage and partnership transit -- not only a mood.
Gochara: Jupiter first reaches 0 Leo about November 2026, stations retrograde in Leo Jan 2027, returns to Cancer, re-enters
Leo July 2027, occupies Leo through late 2027, touches Virgo Jan 2028, retrogrades back into Leo, and leaves for Virgo
more lastingly around Sep 2028. Likely events in the Jul 2027-Sep 2028 overlap with Venus AD: engagement, marriage, a
business partner, a public couple-status, or a radical upgrade of an existing bond. Mere feeling: Nov 2026-Mar 2027 while
Mercury AD / Ketu AD still run -- hope and talks, not the stamp. Do not confuse the first Jupiter-in-Leo sniff with the
wedding date.
20. What is the first Rahu mahadasha antardasha (from Aug 2029) likely to bring?
Rahu-Rahu: 27 August 2029 to 9 May 2032 (2.7 years). Rahu in 11th Mula: expansion of network, foreign or unconventional
income, hunger, relocation themes, a larger game. First Rahu AD is raw. It gives the appetite before the ethics. If Mars-Venus
has already married you to a craft and a person, Rahu-Rahu scales both. If you enter it still unnamed and unpartnered, it can
bring a sudden foreign/status bond or a chaotic 11th-house crowd that is not a life. Do not use 2029-32 to 'finally start'. Use it
to multiply what 2027-28 already started.

21. Give me a 12-month calendar: three months to push, wait, sign, rest. (See table above for 2026-29.)
From today (Sep 2026) the next 12 months are not a balanced four-block. They are: a short push (early Sep), a wait-to-sign
(mid-Sep to early Nov), a sign/talk block (Nov-Dec 2026), then rest-and-cut through Ketu until July 2027. The true push/sign
season begins 20 July 2027. If you try to make Sep 2026-Jul 2027 look like a harvest, you will call Ashtama Shani 'bad luck'
instead of 'toll'.
22. Which year between now and 2032 is not for marriage, property, or a company -- even if I feel ready?
Primary: 21 February 2027 to 20 July 2027 (Mars-Ketu). Secondary: solemnizing a marriage in late 2026 while Rahu still sits
on lagna and Ashtama Shani is in force -- talks yes, stamp no. 2030-31 is not 'forbidden' but it is Rahu-Rahu: oversized,
foreign, hungry. A company or marriage then can work if it is the scaled version of a 2027-28 foundation. It is a poor year to
invent the foundation from a mood.
D. Profession, job, business, money
23. Is this chart better as a named practice / business, or as employment with a path to command?
Named practice is the better native expression: 10th lord in lagna, Sun exalted in the 3rd (own effort), Rahu in 11th
(independent gains), lagna lord in 12th (clients, foreign, research, consulting from behind a door that still has your name on
it). Employment works only if there is a path to command. Mars in lagna will rot as the ghost who makes the principal look
good. Houlding: 6th is labour without advancement; 10th is vocation and honour. You have over-lived the 6th (Moon-Jupiter
there in the Western house system; 6th lord Moon in 7th in Vedic). Move toward 10th.

24. What exact fields do 10th-lord Mars in lagna plus Ashwini Sun in the 3rd support?
Mars in lagna / 10th lord: surgery of bodies or systems, engineering, military or police-adjacent, sports, metallurgy, surgery,
investigation, crisis work, entrepreneurship, technical leadership. Ashwini Sun (DiCara: twin physicians, vitality, the horse):
initiation, emergency, healing, medicine-adjacent, starting things that others finish. 3rd house: writing, media, sales, short
travel, training, hands/skill. 2nd Venus-Mercury (Uttara Bhadrapada: depth, afterlife, wealth, calm after transformation):
counsel, therapy-adjacent speech, design, finance communication, Ayurveda/astrology/consulting, anything that sounds like
care and is priced. 11th Rahu Mula: digital, foreign, research, unconventional networks. Mismatch: a purely decorative
prestige path with no craft; a job whose only reward is being liked; speculative gambling as a career (Ketu 5th will cut it).
25. When is it correct to leave a job where I am indispensable but unnamed?
When the papers of the next thing exist -- ideally signed or at least drafted in Mercury AD (now to Feb 2027), executed as a
life-change in Venus AD (from Jul 2027). Leaving in a rage in Mars PD or Rahu PD (Sep-Nov 2026) without a 2nd-house
structure is 12th-house self-undoing. Leaving never is the South-Node/4th-house family loyalty transplanted onto an
employer. The chart's instruction is the 10th. If they will not put your name on the work by the Venus window, you put your
name on your own work.
26. Jupiter as 2nd and 11th lord in the 7th: should I take a business partner, and what kind would harm me?
The yoga favours partnership income -- spouse or business partner as a wealth door. Take a partner in Mars-Venus or after,
not in Mars-Ketu. Helpful partner: competent, proud, with their own dharma (Leo 7th, Magha), operations/finance skill (your
Mercury is the weak-then-strong document planet -- they should love paperwork), not a yes-person. Harmful partner:
someone you 'improve' (Virgo 7th in the Western chart), someone who collapses under Mars, someone who only criticizes, a
status-hungry Rahu type who uses your 12th-house labour. Jupiter retrograde: you may outgrow the first partner-as-guru.
Write exit clauses. That is not pessimism. That is 8th-lord Mercury in the 2nd.
27. 2nd house Venus-Mercury: money through voice, counsel, trade -- and when do inflows stabilize?
Yes: speech, counsel, design, trade, teaching, billed expertise. Mercury debilitated then cancelled: invoices bounce once, then
clear. Venus exalted: the brand and the price can be beautiful and practical (Singer's April 14 note: beautiful only if useful).
Stabilize: not fully under Ashtama Shani and Saturn transiting the 2nd (now through early 2028). Durable from Mars-Venus
onward, then Rahu 11th scales. Keep 6-12 months of expenses in the 12th-house Saturn style -- not as fear, as structure.
28. Saturn aspecting the 2nd: delayed, restricted, or durable money?
All three, in that order. Saturn in own sign in the 12th aspects the 2nd (3rd aspect). Savings leak to foreign, family duty, or
hidden expenses, then become iron. Do not interpret delay as 'I am not meant to have money.' Interpret it as 'I am not meant to
have unsupervised money.' Accounts are the remedy, not a poorer life.
29. Foreign income vs foreign residence: which does Saturn 12th plus Rahu 11th actually give, and in which
dasha?
Both are in the chart. Lagna lord in 12th own sign is a classic foreign-residence / long-stay-away yoga, especially in a dasha
of Saturn, Rahu, or a 12th occupant. Rahu in 11th is foreign and unconventional gains, including without moving. Mars
dasha: foreign through work, clients, short intense stays, maybe a move if Venus AD coincides with an offer. Rahu MD from
2029: the stronger settlement/scale-abroad period. Charak lists foreign residence as an 'adverse' Venus-under-Mars result --
for this nativity that 'adverse' is often simply living the 12th house on purpose. Choose it; do not slide into it as escape.
30. What is the difference between a lucky windfall and money I must build -- in this chart?
Windfall is not the native language. 11th Rahu can look like a sudden network jackpot in Rahu MD; even then Mula makes
you pay with an uprooting. Built money: 2nd house exaltation + Saturn delay + 10th lord in lagna. You are paid for a named
craft. If an offer requires no skill and high secrecy, it is 12th/8th fog -- Mercury-Neptune weather in the Western transits of
2026-27. Walk away. If it requires your name, your hours, and a contract, it is the chart.
E. Marriage, wife, love

31. Is marriage promised, or a significant partnership that may not be legal marriage?
Marriage is promised as a major yoga: Jupiter in 7th, 7th lord exalted and vargottama, D9 Jupiter in own sign, Moon in Purva
Phalguni (DiCara: romantic enjoyment, Bhaga, marital blessing). The form can be a legal marriage or a public, durable
partnership -- Leo 7th wants visibility. A secret 12th-house arrangement will not satisfy Magha. If family custom requires a
ceremony, the chart supports one in the Venus window. If you refuse marriage as an institution, you still do not get to refuse
the equal.
32. Best dasha/transit window to marry -- and the window that looks fated but is fog?
Best: 20 July 2027 - 18 September 2028 (Mars-Venus) with Jupiter in Leo. Second strike: Mars-Sun Sep 2028 - Jan 2029 (7th
lord). Fog: Rahu PD Sep-Nov 2026; any yes under Neptune-near-personal-planets in the tropical sky of 2026-27; Ketu AD
Feb-Jul 2027 (feels destined because Jupiter is sniffing Leo -- it is a preview). Rushing a wedding in 2026 to 'calm Ashtama
Shani' is using a person as a remedy. That is 6th lord in the 7th: marrying to solve a problem.
33. Describe the spouse from 7th house, 7th lord, Venus, Jupiter, and D9.
7th Leo, Magha Jupiter retrograde, Moon there: warm, proud, visible, loyal to lineage or to her own dignity, emotionally
generous and also capable of drama. Not mousy. 7th lord Sun exalted in 3rd Ashwini: independent, initiating, possibly in a
courageous or healing/communication field, met through effort, siblings, short travel, or your craft. Venus exalted in Pisces in
2nd: attractive in a way that is also useful; taste; family/money matters in the match. D9 Gemini lagna (if birth time holds):
mercurial, witty, dual, needs conversation. D9 Jupiter Pisces: the marriage has a dharmic, guiding quality. Relative status:
Magha and Sun can show a family that takes itself seriously, or a woman who behaves as if it does. Age: Sun/Jupiter can
show equal or a shade more established; not a child-bride script. How you meet: 3rd house -- work, words, a course, a short
trip, a sibling's circle -- not a locked-room fantasy.
34. Mars aspects the 7th; 6th lord Moon sits in the 7th. How will conflict show, and who can hold it?
Mars from lagna aspects 4, 7, 8. Heat in home, marriage, and in-laws. Moon opposite Mars in the Western chart is the same
weather: fight or freeze. 6th lord in 7th: work, health, and 'who is serving whom' become the argument. How it shows:
criticism instead of a need; helpful tone with a jaw; sudden cold; then guilt and over-giving. Who can hold it: a person with
their own Mars -- spine, work, sexual honesty -- who can say 'that was too much' without shaming you for having a will, and
who will not use illness or martyrdom as a weapon (6th in 7th). A yes-person will make you cruel. A pure critic will make
you small.
35. Do you treat Kuja dosha as active (Mars in 1st) or cancelled (Mars in Aquarius)? Why?
Split the difference like a responsible jyotishi. Levacy: Mars in Leo or Aquarius gives no Kuja dosha in any house -- a
standard exception. Some North-Indian lists still count 1st-house Mars. This reading: do not fear a curse; do not skip
matching. The operational fact is Mars's 7th aspect, not a cancelled or uncancelled label. If a matcher panics only at the word
manglik and cannot discuss the aspect, find another matcher.
36. What should I never do in a relationship just to keep peace -- given 12th-house habits vs this lagna?
Never swallow the want and then punish them with competence, silence, or a sudden exit. That is Saturn-Mars in the 12th
(Western) / Saturn 12th + Mars lagna (Vedic). Never become their project manager to feel safe (Virgo Moon on the
descendant in the other system). Never pick a smaller life so they will not call you 'too much' (exalted Sun as 7th lord will not
survive that). Peace that requires self-cancellation is not peace. It is the 12th house collecting interest.
37. If I am already with someone: what in their chart must you see before you bless the match?
